Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.19076

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of October 2024).
source_name: Charles Gong, “Minimizing Monochromatic Subgraphs of K_n,n”, arXiv:2410.19076 (2026).
statement: For $r\in\mathbb{Z}^{+}$, let $a,b:\mathcal{P}([r])\to[0,1]$ be an optimal solution to the coloring problem, and write $a(R)$ and $b(R)$ for the corresponding aggregate quantities associated with $R\subseteq[r]$. **Intersection-support conjecture.** There do not exist subsets $R_1,R_2\subseteq[r]$ such that $|R_1\cap R_2|\geq 2$, $a(R_1)>0$, and $b(R_2)>0$. This is a structural conjecture about every optimal solution and is presented without a resolution in the paper.
title: Intersection-support conjecture for optimal colorings
